headline: Argus Partners advises MakeMyTrip on acquisition of majority stake in Quick Ride
sum: MakeMyTrip India has made a majority stake acquisition in Quick Ride, a Bengaluru-based, technology-led shared mobility platform. The transaction involved an internal restructuring of Quick Ride's business.
detail: MakeMyTrip India has made a majority stake acquisition in Quick Ride, a Bengaluru-based, technology-led shared mobility platform. The transaction involved an internal restructuring of Quick Ride's business. As part of this restructuring, the ride pooling operations were separated from the electric vehicle taxi business. The Quick Ride brand and its ride pooling business were transferred to a new entity, Co Ride Mobility Private Limited, in which MakeMyTrip acquired a majority stake.
